say:28:1710303021:1.text: I thought he was on his way to meet you, but now...

say:31:1710303023:1.text: The Countess' residence... It's also in the upper district!

say:33:1710303024:1.text: Um... our news agency isn't there.

say:35:1710303025:1.text: Anyway, there must be a common thread between the cases. Father must have found something... I must find him at once!

say:1:1710306001:1.source_cn: 队长，您怎么亲自来上城区了！请您下达指示！

say:11:1710306009:0.text: She said she didn't need us Royal Guard anymore...
say:11:1710306009:0.source_cn: 她说有那些就够了，不需要我们……

say:21:1710306018:1.text: ... Kleinford, just hold your position here and don't let anyone get near.

say:4:1710333003:1.source_cn: 可恶！我已经动员了商会成员加以打听，还悬赏了有关圣古堂...

say:9:1710333008:1.source_cn: 罗万，你冷静点！我们现在需要的是线索。

say:6:1710348005:1.source_cn: 升华庆典的喧闹声也不见了……殿下，情况不对。这种寂静太...

say:7:1710348006:1.text: Let's try to leave this place first.

say:8:1710348007:1.text: But this thing doesn't look like it'll give way easily.
say:8:1710348007:1.source_cn: 不过，这东西看起来可不像是一踹就开的木门。

say:9:1710348008:1.text: I can try dispelling it or blowing it apart. No magic barrier is without a flaw.
say:9:1710348008:1.source_cn: 我可以尝试使用魔力解除或者爆破，只要是魔法构成的屏障，...

say:10:1710348009:1.text: Alright, have a crack at it then!

say:11:1710348010:1.text: Cassadee steps forward, gathers mana in her hand, and unleashes a strike at the red barrier sealing the entrance.
say:11:1710348010:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂走上前，魔力汇聚在掌心，试图冲击那层封锁了入口的...

say:12:1710348011:1.text: Yet, the barrier doesn't budge; it devours her mana instead.
say:12:1710348011:1.source_cn: 然而，随着魔力的注入，屏障不仅纹丝不动，反而吞噬了魔力之光。

say:15:1710348014:1.text: That's not the case... The moment my mana made contact with the barrier, something strange happened...
say:15:1710348014:1.source_cn: 不，殿下……刚才……我的魔力接触到屏障的瞬间，却像是……

say:16:1710348015:1.text: ... My mana just vanished, as if it had fallen off a cliff or something.
say:16:1710348015:1.source_cn: ……像是掉进了悬崖一样，瞬间消失了。

say:17:1710348016:1.text: Cassadee approaches the barrier, feeling along its edge, but all she touches is emptiness.
say:17:1710348016:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂走近一步，伸出手在屏障边缘试探，但只感受了一片虚无。

say:18:1710348017:1.text: This barrier isn't just blocking our way out... There's literally nothing beyond it.
say:18:1710348017:1.source_cn: 这不仅仅是屏障……殿下，这层魔法屏障后面什么都没有。

say:19:1710348018:1.text: We seem to be cut off from the world outside.
say:19:1710348018:1.source_cn: 入口的另一边，空间似乎被切断了。

say:20:1710348019:1.text: Cut off? Are you saying we're trapped here?
say:20:1710348019:1.source_cn: 切断？你是说我们出不去了？

say:21:1710348020:1.text: Our connection to the outside world is gone. Neither physical methods nor regular magic can reopen the entrance.
say:21:1710348020:1.source_cn: 物理手段和常规魔法恐怕都不行，因为“路”已经断了。

say:22:1710348021:1.text: But don't worry. I have this magic communicator that Merlin gave me.
say:22:1710348021:1.source_cn: 别担心，殿下。我身上带着梅林大人给我的魔法通讯器。
say:22:1710348021:1.male: But don't worry. I have this magic communicator that Merlin gave me.
say:22:1710348021:1.female: But don't worry. I have this magic communicator that Merlin gave me.

say:23:1710348022:1.text: I'll get in touch with him so he can see what's happening from the outside.
say:23:1710348022:1.source_cn: 我先联络梅林大人，让<male>他</male><fe...
say:23:1710348022:1.male: I'll get in touch with him so he can see what's happening from the outside.
say:23:1710348022:1.female: I'll get in touch with her so she can see what's happening from the outside.

say:24:1710348023:0.text: Cassadee pulls out the communicator and infuses it with magic to make a call.
say:24:1710348023:0.source_cn: 科丝蒂拿出通讯器，注入魔力尝试呼叫。

say:26:1710348024:0.source_cn: 通讯器接通中……滋……滋……通讯器接通中……<key:...

say:27:1710348025:1.source_cn: 通讯器接通中……滋……滋……通讯器接通中……<key:...

say:28:1710348026:1.source_cn: 通讯器接通中……滋……滋……通讯器接通中……<key:...

say:31:1710348028:1.text: The entrance is sealed, and the communicator is of no use...
say:31:1710348028:1.source_cn: 入口被封锁，通讯器也没有用……

say:32:1710348029:1.text: I'm not sure what's going on, but it looks like we're stuck here.
say:32:1710348029:1.source_cn: 虽然不知道发生了什么，但看来我们是被困在这个大厅里了。

say:33:1710348030:1.text: Now the only way out is sealed—
say:33:1710348030:1.source_cn: 殿下，现在唯一的出口被封锁——

say:34:1710348031:1.text: The only way out? Not a chance! This is the Hall of Ancients, after all.
say:34:1710348031:1.source_cn: 谁说只有这一个出口？这里可是圣古堂！

say:36:1710348033:1.text: When I was little, I was always finding ways to avoid those nagging etiquette teachers.
say:36:1710348033:1.source_cn: 小时候，为了躲避那些唠唠叨叨的礼仪老师，我经常在王宫里乱跑。

say:37:1710348034:1.text: One time, I was hiding in my father's chamber and accidentally hit a switch. A door opened, and it led me down a passage straight here.
say:37:1710348034:1.source_cn: 有一次，我在父王的寝殿躲她们，不小心碰到了一个机关，然...

say:38:1710348035:1.text: From the King's chamber to the Hall of Ancients?
say:38:1710348035:1.source_cn: 从国王的寝殿直通圣古堂？

say:39:1710348036:1.text: That's right. My father was horrified when he found me in the passage and warned me sternly not to tell anyone.
say:39:1710348036:1.source_cn: 没错。父王当时发现后吓坏了，严令我不许告诉任何人。

say:40:1710348037:1.text: The secret passage is hidden <style="highlight">in the depths</style> of this hall.
say:40:1710348037:1.source_cn: 那条密道的入口很隐蔽，就在圣古堂的<style=hig...

say:41:1710348038:1.text: Let's see if we can go out from there!
say:41:1710348038:1.source_cn: 既然这里走不通，我们就试试那里吧！

say:42:1710348039:1.source_cn: 走吧，科丝蒂。本公主倒要看看，这条路能不能带我们出去！

say:0:1710349001:0.text: That statue's blocking the path here.
say:0:1710349001:0.source_cn: 这里的路好像被雕像堵死了。

say:1:1710349002:0.text: Why's there a statue here?! We'll find another way!
say:1:1710349002:0.source_cn: 真奇怪，这里怎么会有雕像呢？！我们换个方向试试！

say:0:1710349101:0.text: These two paths are blocked too!
say:0:1710349101:0.source_cn: 这两个方向也被堵住了？

say:1:1710349102:0.text: Hmm, I know what to do with these barriers.
say:1:1710349102:0.source_cn: 唔，这个倒是有办法打开。

say:1:1710349201:1.text: I've seen them in the archives at the Arcane Affairs Office. These are red and blue barriers.
say:1:1710349201:1.source_cn: 殿下，我在魔法事务司的旧档案里见过这个。这是红蓝屏障。

say:2:1710349202:1.text: It's a common defense spell used to secure areas with important supplies and documents.
say:2:1710349202:1.source_cn: 这是魔法师常用的一种通用防御魔法，通常用来封锁存放重要...

say:3:1710349203:0.source_cn: 那为什么会突然出现在圣古堂里？

say:4:1710349204:1.text: I suppose they were dormant before the abnormal magic from the entrance's seal activated them.
say:4:1710349204:1.source_cn: 恐怕是因为刚才那个切断出口的异常魔力波动，使得这些原本...

say:5:1710349205:1.text: Talk about bad luck... Anyway, since you've read about them, you should know the solution, right?
say:5:1710349205:1.source_cn: 真是倒霉……那这个要怎么解开？既然你读过档案，应该知道...

say:6:1710349206:1.text: I do. These barriers operate based on the color resonance rule.
say:6:1710349206:1.source_cn: 是的，这种封印的原理基于同色共鸣法则。

say:7:1710349207:1.text: See the blue crystal switch on the left side of the door? Activating it with magic will disable the blue barrier. The red one works the same way.
say:7:1710349207:1.source_cn: 左侧的门旁有同色晶石机关，只要注入魔力激活蓝色晶石机关...

say:8:1710349208:0.text: Let's get rid of the blue one first, so we can proceed further.
say:8:1710349208:0.source_cn: 那既然我们要往深处走，就得先把挡路的这个蓝色屏障解决掉。

say:9:1710349209:1.text: I'll try infusing the blue crystal with magic!
say:9:1710349209:1.source_cn: 注入魔力吗？我去试试看！

say:0:1710349301:0.text: The crystal's turned red! And the blue barrier's gone! Let's move!
say:0:1710349301:0.source_cn: 机关变红了！左侧的蓝屏障消失了！我们走！

say:1:1710349302:0.text: Hmm, there's a red barrier on the far side.
say:1:1710349302:0.source_cn: 嗯，红色屏障出现在了对面，那里无法通行了。

say:2:1710349501:0.text: Some magic armors are patrolling up ahead!
say:2:1710349501:0.source_cn: 公主殿下，前面有魔法盔甲在巡逻！

say:3:1710349502:0.text: Huh? We have to stay away from them!

say:0:1710359001:0.text: There are no more magic armors ahead.
say:0:1710359001:0.source_cn: 殿下，前方已经没有被魔法驱动的盔甲了。

say:0:1710360001:0.text: There's someone over there! Is that... Commander Hendrik?
say:0:1710360001:0.source_cn: 前面有人！那背影是……亨德里克卿？

say:1:1710361001:0.text: Commander Hendrik! It really is you! It's so wonderful—*cough*—I mean, I'm so surprised to see you here!
say:1:1710361001:0.source_cn: 亨德里克卿！真的是您！太好了，连您也……咳，我是说，您...

say:2:1710361002:1.text: Princess Peggy, I'm relieved to see you safe and well.
say:2:1710361002:1.source_cn: 公主殿下，看到您安然无恙，属下就放心了。

say:3:1710361003:1.text: The Queen and Prince Orion have been deeply worried about you. I was assigned to investigate your disappearance and have mobilized the entire Royal Guard to search for you and the Hall of Ancients.
say:3:1710361003:1.source_cn: 自您失踪后，王后陛下与王子殿下忧心如焚。属下奉命调查此...

say:4:1710361004:0.text: It feels like Cassadee and I have only been here for a short while. Things have escalated so quickly...
say:4:1710361004:0.source_cn: 我和科丝蒂被困在这里，感觉不过才几刻钟而已。外面的动静...

say:5:1710361005:1.text: A short while? After you went missing, I was notified of Alaine's disappearance, and then I went to the Evergreen Exhibition, where I was trapped...
say:5:1710361005:1.source_cn: 几刻钟？殿下，从您失踪，到属下接到阿莱茵女士失踪的报告...

say:6:1710361006:1.text: It couldn't have been just a short while.
say:6:1710361006:1.source_cn: 这期间流逝的时间，绝不仅仅是几刻钟。

say:8:1710361007:1.text: Commander Hendrik, did you encounter anything unusual before being moved here?
say:8:1710361007:1.source_cn: 亨德里克司令，您在被传送此处前有什么异常情况吗？

say:9:1710361008:1.text: I was ambushed in the Evergreen Exhibition.
say:9:1710361008:1.source_cn: 没错。我在调查冬青展览馆的最深处时，遭遇了埋伏。

say:10:1710361009:1.text: A set of <style="highlight">ancient magic armor</style> in the collection suddenly came to life and attacked me.
say:10:1710361009:1.source_cn: 那是馆藏的一具<style=highlight>古代魔...

say:11:1710361010:1.text: I felt disoriented while engaging the armor, and before I knew it, I was here. That armor must have carried some sort of teleportation magic.
say:11:1710361010:1.source_cn: 就在我与它缠斗的过程中，突然感到一阵恍惚，随后人就已经...

say:13:1710361011:1.text: Commander Hendrik, allow me to clarify! I've spent three years studying that armor, and I can assure you its runes only govern defense and counterattacks. It has absolutely no teleportation capabilities.
say:13:1710361011:1.source_cn: 亨德里克司令，容我在此澄清！那具铠甲我研究了整整三年，...

say:14:1710361012:1.text: You're here too, Alaine! If the teleportation had nothing to do with the armor...
say:14:1710361012:1.source_cn: 阿莱茵馆长？您也在。如果不是盔甲，而我当时又确实在与它...

say:15:1710361013:1.text: Then it must've happened to me when I wasn't aware.
say:15:1710361013:1.source_cn: 那我就是在毫无察觉的情况下中招了。

say:17:1710361014:1.text: Some unknown method of teleportation, coupled with this strange discrepancy in the flow of time...
say:17:1710361014:1.source_cn: 未知的传送手段，再加上这诡异的时间流速差……

say:18:1710361015:1.text: We're in an extremely vulnerable position. Not only is magic weaker here, but the <style="highlight">flow of time</style> is distorted to some extent.
say:18:1710361015:1.source_cn: 殿下，我们处于极度的被动中。这里不仅隔绝了魔法通讯，甚...

say:19:1710361016:1.text: Something's very wrong here! We need to get out of here quickly!
say:19:1710361016:1.source_cn: 这里有太多古怪了！我们不能在圣古堂里闲庭信步了，得赶快离开！

say:20:1710361017:1.text: Commander Hendrik, we're now heading to a secret passage known only to the royal family.
say:20:1710361017:1.source_cn: 亨德里克卿，我们先前往只有王室成员才知道的秘密通道吧。

say:21:1710361018:1.text: I need you to bring up the rear to keep everyone safe.
say:21:1710361018:1.source_cn: 这里还有不少被卷进来的无辜者，我需要您殿后，护卫队伍的安全。

say:22:1710361019:1.text: I'll stay at the back, Your Highness. Please lead the way.
say:22:1710361019:1.source_cn: 遵命，公主殿下。属下会守住后方。请殿下带路吧。

say:0:1710362001:0.text: Everyone, please follow Princess Peggy. I'll cover the rear.
say:0:1710362001:0.source_cn: 诸位跟紧公主殿下，我会在最后防御危险。

say:1:1710364001:1.text: Peggy!!! Are you alright? Did you get hurt?
say:1:1710364001:1.source_cn: 佩吉！佩吉！你没事吧？！有没有受伤？

say:3:1710364002:1.text: Hmph, enough fussing, Rowan. I'm not that soft.
say:3:1710364002:1.source_cn: 哼，大惊小怪。罗万，你可别小看我。就凭这些把戏，怎么可...

say:4:1710364003:1.text: Ah, yes, Princess Peggy is the mightiest in all of Savannah.
say:4:1710364003:1.source_cn: 是是是，我忘记了，佩吉公主可是赛凡纳一霸，最厉害了。

say:5:1710364004:1.text: ... You must've been worried sick while I was gone, right?
say:5:1710364004:1.source_cn: ……倒是你。我不在的时候，你是不是急得团团转，到处找我啊？

say:6:1710364005:1.text: N-Not at all... I just didn't want any complications for my business! Yeah, that's it!
say:6:1710364005:1.source_cn: 我、我哪有担心你……我那是担心商会的生意受影响！对，就...

say:8:1710364007:0.text: Don't even get me started. I was at the Consortium HQ, discussing how to rescue you—I mean, all of you—with Magister Merlin and Gwyneth.
say:8:1710364007:0.source_cn: 别提了。我先是在秘银总部，跟梅林阁下和格温妮丝商量着怎...
say:8:1710364007:0.male: Don't even get me started. I was at the Consortium HQ, discussing how to rescue you—I mean, all of you—with Magister Merlin and Gwyneth.
say:8:1710364007:0.female: Don't even get me started. I was at the Consortium HQ, discussing how to rescue you—I mean, all of you—with Magister Merlin and Gwyneth.

say:9:1710364008:0.text: Then I had to step away to handle some work. After I finished signing some documents and was about to head back to them... everything went blurry, and I ended up here!
say:9:1710364008:0.source_cn: 然后就被生意绊住了手脚，我刚签完字，正准备回去找他们汇...

say:10:1710364009:1.text: ... Figures, you can't be trusted when it matters most.
say:10:1710364009:1.source_cn: 这都是什么啊……果然你这家伙关键时刻靠不住。

say:12:1710364010:1.text: Aww, you lovebirds are so sweet!
say:12:1710364010:1.source_cn: 哎呀，虽然出场方式狼狈了点，但这情谊，真是让我们这些老...

say:13:1710364011:0.text: Ah, it's so great to be young!
say:13:1710364011:0.source_cn: 哎呦——可不是嘛！年轻真好！

say:14:1710364012:0.text: Wow, it's packed in here! Viscount Urswick, Madam Alaine, Countess Caloren, and the Chief Justice?!
say:14:1710364012:0.source_cn: 哇！这里怎么那么多人！乌瑟斯子爵、阿莱茵馆长、凯洛伦夫...

say:15:1710364013:0.source_cn: 啊，还有亨德里克司令？！您真的在这里！

say:16:1710364014:1.text: Gwyneth was beside herself when she found out you were missing!
say:16:1710364014:1.source_cn: 刚才在秘银商会，格温妮丝发现您失踪的时候，简直急疯了！

say:18:1710364015:0.text: Gwyneth... I feel bad for putting my daughter through that.
say:18:1710364015:0.source_cn: 格温妮丝……是我让她担心了。身为父亲，却让女儿如此焦急...

say:19:1710364016:1.text: Anyway, the situation's getting worse, with more people likely to be sent in.
say:19:1710364016:1.source_cn: 不过，既然罗万少爷此时也被传送进来，这意味着有可能会有...

say:21:1710364017:1.text: We need to get out fast and find the truth. With King Rolan's coffin before us, the secret passage can't be far.
say:21:1710364017:1.source_cn: 嗯，当务之急是尽快离开，去外面弄清真相。幸好我们现在正...

say:22:1710364018:0.text: I first stumbled on this passage when I was little... Now that I'm bigger and taller, I'll need some time to find the switch.
say:22:1710364018:0.source_cn: 但我发现那条路的时候还很小……我是从柱子和雕像的缝隙钻...

say:24:1710364020:1.text: It's been an exhausting journey for everyone. Why don't we rest here for a while and wait for Princess Peggy?
say:24:1710364020:1.source_cn: 既然如此，诸位大人一路走来，体力消耗很大。不如在此稍作...

say:25:1710364021:1.text: You make a good point. Everyone, take a fifteen-minute rest here. Rowan, come with me!
say:25:1710364021:1.source_cn: 亨德里克卿言之有理。大家先原地休息一刻钟。罗万，跟我来这边！

say:27:1710364022:1.text: I'll give the communicator another try then...
say:27:1710364022:1.source_cn: 那我也再试着联络一下梅林大人吧，希望这次能联络上……
say:27:1710364022:1.male: I'll give the communicator another try then...
say:27:1710364022:1.female: I'll give the communicator another try then...

say:30:1710364023:0.text: Cassadee moves to a quiet corner and infuses the communicator with magic.
say:30:1710364023:0.source_cn: 科丝蒂拿着通讯器走向一旁，对着其再次注入魔力。

say:31:1710364024:0.text: To her excitement, the communicator is responding this time!
say:31:1710364024:0.source_cn: 令人兴奋的是，这次通讯器好像有了反应！

say:34:1710364025:0.text: ... Magister Merlin! Can you hear me...
say:34:1710364025:0.male: ... Magister Merlin! Can you hear me...
say:34:1710364025:0.female: ... Magister Merlin! Can you hear me...

narration:35:1710364026:0.text: This is what Peggy and Cassadee have experienced in the Hall of Ancients so far...
narration:35:1710364026:0.source_cn: 这就是佩吉和科丝蒂在圣古堂中遭遇的一切……

say:39:1710364027:0.text: So the Hall of Ancients has become a distorted realm, where time itself flows differently than in the outside world...
say:39:1710364027:0.source_cn: 也就是说，你们身处的圣古堂，不仅是一个发生了异变的空间...

say:40:1710364028:0.text: Father, Rowan, and the other nobles were teleported there.
say:40:1710364028:0.source_cn: 父亲，罗万，还有那些消失的贵族，都是瞬间被传送到了圣古堂。

say:41:1710364029:0.text: Can magic really accomplish all that?
say:41:1710364029:0.source_cn: 梅林阁下，这一切真是魔法能做到的吗？
say:41:1710364029:0.male: Can magic really accomplish all that?
say:41:1710364029:0.female: Can magic really accomplish all that?

choice_prompt:42:1710364029.text: Can magic really accomplish all that?
choice_prompt:42:1710364029.source_cn: 梅林阁下，这一切真是魔法能做到的吗？
choice_prompt:42:1710364029.male: Can magic really accomplish all that?
choice_prompt:42:1710364029.female: Can magic really accomplish all that?

say:43:1710364030:0.text: Your Highness, we've identified a link between all the missing person cases—
say:43:1710364030:0.source_cn: 公主殿下，关于进入圣古堂的线索，我们发现——

say:49:1710364032:1.text: Everyone, stay alert and protect the princess!

narration:51:1710364033:0.text: The light on the communicator flickers out the very next moment.
narration:51:1710364033:0.source_cn: 通讯器上的光芒瞬间熄灭

narration:52:1710364034:0.text: Sounds like Peggy and the others are under attack!
narration:52:1710364034:0.source_cn: 圣古堂内的佩吉她们似乎遭遇了什么袭击——

choice:42:0:1.text: It involves highly advanced spatial magic.
choice:42:0:1.male: It involves highly advanced spatial magic.
choice:42:0:1.female: It involves highly advanced spatial magic.

say:1:1710368001:0.text: Where did all these Hypofiends come from?! Cassadee, can you keep going?!
say:1:1710368001:0.source_cn: ……为什么会突然出现这么多魔物！科丝蒂，你还能撑住吗？

say:2:1710368002:1.text: I can! I won't let them get anywhere near you and the others!
say:2:1710368002:1.source_cn: ……我还能坚持！绝对不能让它们伤害公主殿下和大家！

say:4:1710368003:1.text: Oh no, we're finished... Dura above, please grant us your protection...
say:4:1710368003:1.source_cn: 完了……全完了……艾雅在上，请女神保佑……

say:6:1710368004:1.text: Tannis, praying won't help us now! Do something practical if you really want to help!
say:6:1710368004:1.source_cn: 坦尼斯！现在祈祷有什么用？不如想点实际的办法！

say:8:1710368005:1.text: Your Highness, the Hypofiends won't stop coming. Magister Cassadee and I can't hold on much longer.
say:8:1710368005:1.source_cn: 殿下，魔物源源不断，仅凭我和宫廷魔法师恐怕无法护住所有人。

say:9:1710368006:1.text: Please lead everyone to retreat. I'll cover the rear!
say:9:1710368006:1.source_cn: 请您带着大家继续往后撤离，我来断后！

say:11:1710368007:1.text: Retreat?! The route behind us is blocked! We have nowhere to go!
say:11:1710368007:1.source_cn: 往后撤离？！后面的路被堵上了，哪有地方可去……！

say:12:1710368008:1.text: It's a dead end behind us!
say:12:1710368008:1.source_cn: 后面是死路！你们也撑不了多久的！

say:13:1710368009:1.text: ... Wait, there's one more thing I could try. It could turn the tide and keep everyone safe...
say:13:1710368009:1.source_cn: ……不，还有一个办法。一个能够瞬间逆转局势，保护所有人...

say:14:1710368010:1.text: Peggy's gaze settles on the sword lodged in the massive stone, and in that moment, everyone understands her intent...
say:14:1710368010:1.source_cn: 佩吉的目光落在了那把插在巨石之中的长剑上，而所有人顺着...

say:16:1710368011:1.text: Your Highness! A-Are you seriously thinking of...
say:16:1710368011:1.source_cn: 公主殿下！您……您难道是想……？！

say:17:1710368012:1.text: Dura bestowed this divine sword upon Rolan Augusta during the First Divine War. Legend says King Rolan wielded it to slay the Hypofiends and went on to found the Lightbearer Empire.
say:17:1710368012:1.source_cn: 第一次神魔大战时，艾雅女神赐予了罗兰·奥古斯塔这把圣剑...

say:18:1710368013:1.text: That sword, <style="highlight">Excalibur</style>, is right within our reach!

say:19:1710368014:1.text: Your Highness, that sword is a sacred relic representing the throne!
say:19:1710368014:1.source_cn: 绝对不行！公主殿下！那是象征王权继承的神器！

say:20:1710368015:1.text: Our law decrees that the sword can only be touched by the royal heir, and only at the coronation ceremony!
say:20:1710368015:1.source_cn: 依照耀光律法，唯有举行拔剑仪式时，候选继承者方可尝试触...

say:21:1710368016:1.text: If Your Highness were to draw the sword with the King still alive, it would amount to treachery and an attempt at usurpation!
say:21:1710368016:1.source_cn: 陛下尚在，您若此刻私自拔剑，那就是僭越！是谋逆！

say:22:1710368017:1.text: ... I agree with the Chief Justice. This concerns the future of the empire, and the sword shouldn't be drawn on a whim!
say:22:1710368017:1.source_cn: 殿下……大法官说得没错。拔剑之举事关大统，不可如此轻率...

say:23:1710368018:1.text: On a whim? Just look around you!
say:23:1710368018:1.source_cn: 轻率？亨德里克卿，康拉德卿。看看你们周围！

say:24:1710368019:1.text: If I don't draw the sword now, we could all perish here!
say:24:1710368019:1.source_cn: 如果我现在不拔剑，这里的所有人都可能会死！

say:26:1710368021:1.text: The blood of House Augusta runs in me. If I'm destined to be trapped here...
say:26:1710368021:1.source_cn: 我是耀光的公主，我的血管里流淌着奥古斯塔家族的血。如果...

say:27:1710368022:1.text: ... I'm willing to bear the consequences of drawing the sword...
say:27:1710368022:1.source_cn: ……那么，为了守护大家，这份罪名，我背了！

narration:0:1710368501:1.text: The sudden loss of contact leaves you and Gwyneth deeply worried. Just as you start discussing your next move...
narration:0:1710368501:1.male: The sudden loss of contact leaves you and Gwyneth deeply worried. Just as you start discussing your next move...
narration:0:1710368501:1.female: The sudden loss of contact leaves you and Gwyneth deeply worried. Just as you start discussing your next move...

narration:1:1710368502:1.text: Your eyes follow the figure zipping past, and you realize it is Rowan!
narration:1:1710368502:1.male: Your eyes follow the figure zipping past, and you realize it is Rowan!
narration:1:1710368502:1.female: Your eyes follow the figure zipping past, and you realize it is Rowan!

say:1:1710370001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, a-am I really back? Where's Peggy?! Have you seen her?!
say:1:1710370001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, a-am I really back? Where's Peggy?! Have you seen her?!
say:1:1710370001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, a-am I really back? Where's Peggy?! Have you seen her?!

choice_prompt:2:1710370001.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, a-am I really back? Where's Peggy?! Have you seen her?!
choice_prompt:2:1710370001.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，我、我真的回来了？佩吉呢？！你们看到佩吉了吗？！
choice_prompt:2:1710370001.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, a-am I really back? Where's Peggy?! Have you seen her?!
choice_prompt:2:1710370001.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, a-am I really back? Where's Peggy?! Have you seen her?!

say:3:1710370002:1.text: Only me?! But... Peggy was right behind me! She tried to draw Excalibur from the stone, but she failed...
say:3:1710370002:1.source_cn: 只有我？！不……佩吉刚刚就在我身后的，她试着去拔那柄石...

choice_prompt:4:1710370002.text: Only me?! But... Peggy was right behind me! She tried to draw Excalibur from the stone, but she failed...
choice_prompt:4:1710370002.source_cn: 只有我？！不……佩吉刚刚就在我身后的，她试着去拔那柄石中剑，但是失败了……

say:5:1710370003:1.text: Give me some time to gather my thoughts... Whew, here's what happened...
say:5:1710370003:1.source_cn: 让我冷静一下——呼，事情是这样的……

say:6:1710370004:1.text: A large horde of Hypofiends attacked us. We fought with all our strength, but were still forced to retreat...
say:6:1710370004:1.source_cn: 我们突然遭遇了魔物袭击，大家奋力抵抗，但还是被逼的后退……

say:7:1710370005:1.text: Peggy tried to save everyone by reaching for the sword, but she couldn't draw it...
say:7:1710370005:1.source_cn: 佩吉为了保护大家，跑去拔剑，但是没有成功……

say:8:1710370006:1.text: I braced myself for the end as the Hypofiends lunged at us, but just then, Excalibur moved on its own!
say:8:1710370006:1.source_cn: 然后魔物冲了过来，我以为我们要死了……可那把石中剑自己动了！

say:9:1710370007:1.text: I saw it hover in the air, radiating a warm divine light!
say:9:1710370007:1.source_cn: 我亲眼看见那柄石中剑自己漂浮在了空中，爆发出一阵温暖的圣光！

say:10:1710370008:1.text: Those Hypofiends just vanished into the light.
say:10:1710370008:1.source_cn: 接着那些魔物就在光芒中消失了……

say:11:1710370009:1.text: And then, I found myself back here!

choice_prompt:12:1710370009.text: And then, I found myself back here!

say:14:1710370010:0.text: The sword awakened on its own to protect everyone...
say:14:1710370010:0.source_cn: 佩吉殿下没能拔出剑，剑却为了保护众人而自动觉醒……

say:15:1710370011:1.text: Did King Rolan's spirit truly appear in the Hall of Ancients?
say:15:1710370011:1.source_cn: 石中剑……难道说，真的是罗兰大帝的英灵在冥冥之中庇佑着...

say:16:1710370012:1.text: No matter what, I'm back now... Does that mean everyone else is too?
say:16:1710370012:1.source_cn: 不管是谁显灵，既然那道光把我送回来了，那佩吉和科丝蒂…...

choice_prompt:17:1710370012.text: No matter what, I'm back now... Does that mean everyone else is too?
choice_prompt:17:1710370012.source_cn: 不管是谁显灵，既然那道光把我送回来了，那佩吉和科丝蒂……还有亨德里克司令他们，会不会也回来了？

say:18:1710370013:1.text: Ah, the Hall of Ancients is probably back in the plaza! If it's back, then Peggy must be too!
say:18:1710370013:1.source_cn: 对！圣古堂！说不定圣古堂已经回到了广场上！那佩吉肯定也...

say:19:1710370014:1.text: If Father has returned, the plaza will be the first place he goes to restore order. We must head there at once!
say:19:1710370014:1.source_cn: 父亲如果回来了，一定会第一时间整顿广场秩序。事不宜迟，...

choice:17:0:1.text: Maybe the Hall of Ancients is back too.
choice:17:0:1.male: Maybe the Hall of Ancients is back too.
choice:17:0:1.female: Maybe the Hall of Ancients is back too.

choice:12:0:1.text: The sword moved on its own?
choice:12:0:1.male: The sword moved on its own?
choice:12:0:1.female: The sword moved on its own?

choice:12:1:2.text: I can't wrap my head around this.
choice:12:1:2.male: I can't wrap my head around this.
choice:12:1:2.female: I can't wrap my head around this.

choice:4:1:2.text: The communicator stopped working a while ago.
choice:4:1:2.male: The communicator stopped working a while ago.
choice:4:1:2.female: The communicator stopped working a while ago.

choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 只有你一个人突然出现了

say:0:1710371001:0.text: Those nobles over there were trapped in the chapel.
say:0:1710371001:0.source_cn: 前面那些贵族，是之前圣古堂里面的……
say:0:1710371001:0.male: Those nobles over there were trapped in the chapel.
say:0:1710371001:0.female: Those nobles over there were trapped in the chapel.

say:1:1710371002:0.text: They seem to be talking about what happened inside. Let's listen in.
say:1:1710371002:0.source_cn: 他们好像也在说圣古堂内的事情，听听看吧。
say:1:1710371002:0.male: They seem to be talking about what happened inside. Let's listen in.
say:1:1710371002:0.female: They seem to be talking about what happened inside. Let's listen in.

say:0:1710372001:0.text: Princess Peggy didn't draw the sword...
say:0:1710372001:0.source_cn: 佩吉公主没有拔出石中剑……

say:1:1710372002:0.text: How did it manage to float mid-air?
say:1:1710372002:0.source_cn: 那把剑是怎么浮在半空的？

say:2:1710372003:0.text: It must've been King Rolan's spirit!
say:2:1710372003:0.source_cn: 一定是罗兰大帝显灵了！

say:1:1710373001:1.text: Excuse me, is what you just said true? There were Hypofiends inside the chapel?!
say:1:1710373001:1.source_cn: 几位大人，你们刚刚说的事是真的吗？在圣古堂内遭遇了魔物？！

say:2:1710373002:1.text: It's absolutely true! We all thought we were going to die when the Hypofiends closed in on us, but I... *cough* stayed calm and kept everyone's spirits up!
say:2:1710373002:1.source_cn: 真的不能再真了！我们被魔物包围了，本来以为死定了……但...

say:3:1710373003:1.text: Oh, please, Tannis. I still remember how panicked you looked! The truth is, King Rolan's spirit manifested and saved us!
say:3:1710373003:1.source_cn: 噢，闭嘴吧坦尼斯！是神迹！明明是罗兰大帝显灵了！

say:4:1710373004:1.text: Just when we lost all hope, King Rolan's spirit wiped out the Hypofiends with Excalibur and brought us back from that hellish place!
say:4:1710373004:1.source_cn: 在那绝望的时刻，是罗兰大帝的英灵驾驭着石中剑，清除了魔...

say:5:1710373005:1.text: Sorry to interrupt, Countess Cappella. You said everyone came back... but there are only three of you here. Why's that?
say:5:1710373005:1.source_cn: 那个……卡佩洛伯爵，请等一下。您说大家都救回来了……可...

say:7:1710373007:1.text: Where's Princess Peggy and the other missing nobles?
say:7:1710373007:1.source_cn: 佩吉公主呢？还有其他消失的贵族们呢？

say:8:1710373008:1.text: I-I don't know! Princess Peggy was right there when the light shone...
say:8:1710373008:1.source_cn: 我……我不知道！刚才光芒亮起的时候，公主就在附近啊……

say:9:1710373009:1.text: Her Highness... she only reached for the sword to save our lives...
say:9:1710373009:1.source_cn: 她……她明明是为了救我们才冲上去拔剑的……

say:11:1710373010:1.text: The princess reached for the sword? What happened then? Did Her Highness manage to draw it?
say:11:1710373010:1.source_cn: 冲上去拔剑？那结果呢？公主拔出石中剑了吗？

say:12:1710373011:1.source_cn: ……很遗憾，那把剑并没有回应她。

say:13:1710373012:1.text: What?! Do you mean Princess Peggy failed to draw Excalibur?
say:13:1710373012:1.source_cn: 没有回应？！您是说，公主殿下没能拔出石中剑？

say:15:1710373013:1.text: As someone who witnessed the moment firsthand, I'll give you an honest account of what happened...
say:15:1710373013:1.source_cn: 作为亲历者，我必须诚实地陈述那一刻的事实——

say:16:1710373014:1.text: As the Hypofiends swarmed us, Princess Peggy attempted to draw the sword in desperation.
say:16:1710373014:1.source_cn: 当魔物袭来，我们危在旦夕之时，佩吉公主殿下确实第一时间...

say:17:1710373015:1.text: Nevertheless... it didn't budge, no matter how much Her Highness tried.
say:17:1710373015:1.source_cn: 但……无论她如何努力，那柄象征着王权的石中剑都没因她而动摇。

say:18:1710373016:1.text: In the end, the sword unsheathed itself, banishing the Hypofiends with its divine light and bringing us back here.
say:18:1710373016:1.source_cn: 最后，是剑自己出鞘，用神圣的光芒清除魔物，并将我们这些...

say:20:1710373017:1.text: M-Maybe the others are back too, just not with us?
say:20:1710373017:1.source_cn: 其他人、其他人一定跟我们一样回来了，只是没在一起……吧？

say:0:1710373101:1.text: Instead of worrying about the other missing persons, the nearby citizens are fixated on Peggy's failure to draw Excalibur.
say:0:1710373101:1.source_cn: 而此时，民众顾不上担忧其他失踪的人，而是将讨论集中在了...

say:1:1710373201:1.text: You heard that? The chief editor said the princess failed to draw the sword!
say:1:1710373201:1.source_cn: 听到了吗？主编亲口说的！公主拔不出剑！

say:2:1710373202:1.text: I bet King Rolan doesn't see Princess Peggy as fit for the throne!
say:2:1710373202:1.source_cn: 一定是大帝在以此昭告天下——佩吉根本没有资格继承那个位置！

say:3:1710373203:1.text: Can't you see? This whole thing was staged!
say:3:1710373203:1.source_cn: 你们还不明白吗？这根本不是意外！

say:4:1710373204:1.text: With the King gravely ill, the Queen is clinging to the throne instead of passing power to Prince Orion.
say:4:1710373204:1.source_cn: 国王陛下病重已久，王后却迟迟不肯将权力交给王子，反而借...

say:5:1710373205:1.text: And now her daughter tried to pull Excalibur by force... Clearly, the Queen and the Princess are after the throne!
say:5:1710373205:1.source_cn: 现在她女儿又跑去强拔石中剑……这对母女，分明是想窃取王权！

say:7:1710373206:1.text: Hmm... Now that I think about it, I suppose Princess Peggy was a bit too full of herself at the time...
say:7:1710373206:1.source_cn: 哎呀……现在回想起来，当时公主殿下的态度确实有些……太...

say:8:1710373207:1.text: Tsk tsk tsk, she showed no respect at all to her ancestors!
say:8:1710373207:1.source_cn: 啧啧啧，那种势在必得的样子，真是对先祖毫无敬畏之心啊。

say:10:1710373208:1.text: I agree! The Chief Justice tried to stop her, but she wouldn't listen and insisted on going her own way!
say:10:1710373208:1.source_cn: 没错！当时连大法官阁下都劝阻她了，可公主殿下根本听不进...

say:11:1710373209:1.text: How arrogant! Can you believe the Queen raised her daughter like that?!
say:11:1710373209:1.source_cn: 听听！多狂妄啊！这就是王后教出来的女儿！

say:12:1710373210:1.text: Acting as regent is just the Queen's excuse to stage a coup! Even King Rolan manifested to set things right!
say:12:1710373210:1.source_cn: 什么摄政，我看就是篡位的前兆！罗兰大帝一定是看不下去了！

say:13:1710373211:1.text: King Rolan would never allow anyone to usurp the throne through unlawful means!
say:13:1710373211:1.source_cn: 他这是在用这种方式警告王后————想让你的女儿通过花招...

say:0:1710374001:0.text: How could they speak ill of Peggy like that! She went out of her way to save their lives...
say:0:1710374001:0.source_cn: 他们怎么能这么说！佩吉明明为了救他们那么努力……
say:0:1710374001:0.male: How could they speak ill of Peggy like that! She went out of her way to save their lives...
say:0:1710374001:0.female: How could they speak ill of Peggy like that! She went out of her way to save their lives...

say:1:1710374002:0.text: We don't have time to argue with them. Let's find Peggy first.
say:1:1710374002:0.source_cn: 现在不是争辩的时候，得先找到佩吉再说！
say:1:1710374002:0.male: We don't have time to argue with them. Let's find Peggy first.
say:1:1710374002:0.female: We don't have time to argue with them. Let's find Peggy first.

say:0:1710375001:0.text: What?! The Hall of Ancients is still missing!
say:0:1710375001:0.source_cn: 怎么会？圣古堂没有回来？！

say:1:1710375002:0.text: ... Let me check with the guards on duty.
say:1:1710375002:0.source_cn: ……我先问问执勤的守备军，到底是什么情况。

say:1:1710376001:1.text: Byrne, has anything unusual happened around here?
say:1:1710376001:1.source_cn: 伯恩！汇报一下情况。圣古堂消失的原址有何异常吗？

say:3:1710376002:1.text: Captain, there has been no unusual activity, and no one has come near or tried to enter.
say:3:1710376002:1.source_cn: 报告队长！目前原址没有任何动静。也没有任何人靠近或试图闯入！

say:4:1710376003:1.text: What about... the missing people? Any updates on Princess Peggy or Commander Hendrik?
say:4:1710376003:1.source_cn: 那么……失踪人员呢？有没有佩吉公主，或者亨德里克司令的消息？

say:5:1710376004:1.text: Yes, an urgent report just came in. The Commander's back!
say:5:1710376004:1.source_cn: 关于这个，我们刚刚接到了紧急通报。司令他现身了！

say:6:1710376005:1.text: Fath—The Commander's back?! Where is he?
say:6:1710376005:1.source_cn: 父——司令回来了？！他在哪里？

say:7:1710376006:1.text: Those on duty in the palace saw him there.
say:7:1710376006:1.source_cn: 司令出现在了王宫内部，现在已经被宫内执勤的同僚接应了。

say:9:1710376008:0.text: The report says the Commander was alone. At present, there's no news on either Princess Peggy or Magister Cassadee...
say:9:1710376008:0.source_cn: 据通报说，司令是独自一人出现的。关于佩吉公主和宫廷魔法...

say:11:1710376009:0.text: Where in the world is Peggy? I have to get to the palace right away. Maybe she's stranded somewhere nearby!
say:11:1710376009:0.source_cn: 佩吉那家伙，到底去哪里了……不行，我也得去王宫看看，她...

choice_prompt:12:1710376009.text: Where in the world is Peggy? I have to get to the palace right away. Maybe she's stranded somewhere nearby!
choice_prompt:12:1710376009.source_cn: 佩吉那家伙，到底去哪里了……不行，我也得去王宫看看，她可能被传送到了王宫周边的什么地方！

say:13:1710376010:1.text: Father must've brought back crucial information about the Hall of Ancients.
say:13:1710376010:1.source_cn: 没错。父亲既然已经脱险，他一定是带回了关于圣古堂最关键...

say:14:1710376011:1.text: Let's head to the palace and get more details from him!
say:14:1710376011:1.source_cn: 走！立刻去王宫，向父亲确认具体的情况！

say:0:1710383001:0.text: Maybe we aren't the only ones trapped here! Let's move forward and search!
say:0:1710383001:0.source_cn: 也许不止有这些人被困在这里，我们再向前仔细找找！
say:0:1710383001:0.male: Maybe we aren't the only ones trapped here! Let's move forward and search!
say:0:1710383001:0.female: Maybe we aren't the only ones trapped here! Let's move forward and search!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1710363001:.text: There's someone at King Rolan's coffin!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1710363001:.source_cn: 有人出现在了大帝棺椁前？！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1710338002:.text: Master Rowan needs a little more time to sort things out...
cinematic_dialogue:1:1710338002:.source_cn: 罗万少爷还需要一段时间处理工作……

cinematic_dialogue:1:1710367001:.source_cn: 佩吉，别怕！我会保护你的！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1710347001:.text: Eh? Why has it gone so dark all of a sudden?

cinematic_dialogue:1:1710302001:.source_cn: 夫人失踪了！你们快想想办法！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1710302002:.text: Th-The Chief Justice! I-I can't find him either!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1710302002:.source_cn: 这……法官大人他、他也不见了！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1710302003:.text: The chief editor's gone too! This is headline-worthy!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1710302003:.source_cn: 主编也是，这、这似乎是个大新闻！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1710302004:.text: Speak one at a time, please!
